nodes.label: aerol.radiation.v1
nodes.rationale: Absorbed dose keeps Gy; dose equivalent keeps Sv; area monitor cannot be flagged as personal dosimeter.

nodes.label: Shared record fields (value_origin, mission_phase, exposure_region)
nodes.rationale: Unavailable values are null, never 0.

nodes.label: Simulated Devices (wristband + personal dosimeter)
nodes.rationale: No real hardware connected; not a medical device; no NASA endorsement.

nodes.label: Crucian et al. 2015 (ISS immune study)
nodes.rationale: L-180 baseline chosen because later pre-flight samples may reflect pre-mission stress.

nodes.label: NASA RadLab ISS DosTel1/2
nodes.rationale: Area monitor absorbed dose rate (uGy/h), not personal dosimeter, not converted to Sv.

nodes.label: OSD-569 Inspiration4 CBC
nodes.rationale: Different people from the Twins Study - never paired.

nodes.label: Corrections applied to the combined report
nodes.norm_label: corrections applied to the combined report
nodes.rationale: Projections stored as digitized_reference; 1.84 mSv/day is MSL RAD cruise reference not a threshold; no 104% career-limit percentage; no fabricated R+0 TERRA.

nodes.label: Alert rules (aerol.rules.v1)
nodes.rationale: Episodes + cooldown prevent repeats; escalation on worsening; ack never resolves; data-quality rules separate; TERRA/WBC forecast rules are research review only.

nodes.label: Radiation feature window (80% coverage rule)
nodes.rationale: Missing coverage not filled or scaled; 422 below 80% coverage; station detector features are not organ dose.

nodes.label: Learned Model Mode (aerol.learned.terra, unavailable)
nodes.rationale: Disabled: no matched longitudinal data (one TERRA astronaut, no pre-flight baseline; I4 CBC has no TERRA).

nodes.label: Radiation arithmetic / dose integration
nodes.rationale: Piecewise-constant segments split at transitions; gaps never zero-filled; cumulative counter preferred to avoid double counting.

nodes.label: Scenario sensitivity range
nodes.rationale: Envelope over adjustable assumptions, explicitly not confidence/prediction intervals.

nodes.label: TERRA Simulator (aerol.sim.terra)
nodes.rationale: F(t)=max(0,1+S+R+L); transparent, not trained or validated; residual noise only on simulated lab samples.

nodes.label: WBC Simulator (aerol.sim.wbc)
nodes.rationale: Modeled separately; TERRA not assumed to drive WBC; higher WBC not interpreted as better immunity.

nodes.label: Key Design Rules
nodes.rationale: Watch never measures TERRA/WBC; ack never resolves alerts; recovery score never suppresses alerts; missing data never shows all clear; no bone-density features.

nodes.label: Six Canonical Mission Phases
nodes.rationale: Phases kept separate from exposure regions and from events.

nodes.label: Shared Simulation Clock
nodes.rationale: Watch and dashboard share one store and clock (synced across tabs) so they never disagree; ground view deliberately delayed by simulated packets.
